cohort: 114 pregnant women with COVID-19 admitted to a tertiary care center in India between June 18, 2020 and September 30, 2020.
finding: COVID-19 in pregnancy was associated with various adverse obstetric outcomes including cesarean delivery, ruptured tubal ectopic pregnancy, ruptured uterus, obstructed labor, incomplete abortion, stillbirth, oligohydramnios, and thrombocytopenia.
mod_finding: 22 out of 114 participants (19.3%) delivered by cesarean section.
